newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Jan-May steel exports 274,245 t - agency.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Jan-May steel exports 274,245 t - agency.

text.p: Yugoslavia exported 274,245 steel products in the first five months of 1997, 269,505 tonnes more than in the same period last year, state news agency Tanjug reported on Tuesday.

Out of this figure 174,190 tonnes of steel products were exported to industrial nations, 1,065 to developing countries and 98,985 tonnes to transition countries, the federal statistics office was quoted as saying.
In the same period 103,181 tonnes of steel products were imported which is 10,442 tonnes more than the same period in 1996.
Out of the total, 92,739 tonnes were imported from transition countries, 10,058 from industrial countries and 383 tonnes from developing countries.
Final products accounted for 59,384 and semi-finished products for 43,797 tonnes of imports. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom 381 11 311 4305
